import json, math
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from collections import defaultdict
# Analysis reads complete snapshots only. No external files, network or engine calls.
DATES = ["2024-01-01","2024-07-01","2025-01-01","2025-07-01","2026-01-01"]
SIDES = ("P","OI")
GLOBAL_SELECTOR = ["OI"]*4  # Four train-only decisions frozen before corresponding evaluations.
def stamp(date):
    return int(datetime.fromisoformat(date).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp())
EDGES = [stamp(x) for x in DATES]
def pf(trades):
    positive=math.fsum(t["PNL"] for t in trades if t["PNL"]>0)
    negative=math.fsum(t["PNL"] for t in trades if t["PNL"]<0)
    return dict(value=positive/abs(negative) if negative else None,
                no_losses=negative==0 and positive>0, positive_pnl=positive,negative_pnl=negative)
def read(name,start,finish):
    d=json.load(open("inputs/"+name+".json"))
    s=d["summary"]; m=d["metrics"]; form=s["form"]
    assert s["session_status"]=="finished", name
    assert form["start_date"]==start and form["finish_date"]==finish, name
    assert form["config"]["exchange"]["balance"]==10000
    assert len({t["id"] for t in d["trades"]})==len(d["trades"])
    curve=next(c["data"] for c in d["equity_curve"] if c["name"]=="Portfolio")
    curve=sorted(curve,key=lambda p:p["time"])
    first,last=stamp(start),stamp(finish)
    assert len(curve)==(last-first)//86400+1, "Incomplete daily equity"
    assert len({p["time"] for p in curve})==len(curve)
    assert curve[0]["value"]==10000
    terminal=float(m["finishing_balance"])
    assert math.isfinite(terminal) and terminal>0
    # Daily samples label end-of-day at next 00:01; final 00:00 also belongs to previous month.
    # Terminal post-liquidation balance overrides final monthly sample, never earlier periods.
    months={}
    for point in curve:
        when=point["time"]-61 if point["time"]>first else point["time"]
        key=datetime.fromtimestamp(when,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")
        months[key]=dict(equity=float(point["value"]),raw_time=point["time"])
    endmonth=datetime.fromtimestamp(last-1,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")
    assert endmonth in months
    months[endmonth]["equity"]=terminal
    previous=10000.; monthly=[]
    for month,point in sorted(months.items()):
        monthly.append(dict(month=month,return_pct=100*(point["equity"]/previous-1),**point))
        previous=point["equity"]
    assert len(monthly)==(6 if name.startswith("wf_") else 24)
    d["_curve"]=curve;d["_months"]=months;d["_monthly"]=monthly
    d["_terminal"]=terminal;d["_curve_terminal_delta"]=curve[-1]["value"]-terminal
    d["_session_id"]=s["session_id"];d["_pf"]=pf(d["trades"])
    d["_ledger"]=m.get("funding",{}).get("ledger",[])
    assert all(first*1000<=x["effective_at"]<last*1000 for x in d["_ledger"])
    return d
WF={(side,i):read("wf_"+side+"_C"+str(i+1),DATES[i],DATES[i+1])
    for side in SIDES for i in range(4)}
RP={side:read("replay_"+side,DATES[0],DATES[-1]) for side in SIDES}
def replay_semesters(d):
    result=[]; previous=10000.
    for i in range(4):
        month=datetime.fromtimestamp(EDGES[i+1]-1,timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m")
        point=d["_months"][month]
        value=point["equity"]
        result.append(dict(fold="C"+str(i+1),start=DATES[i],finish=DATES[i+1],
            begin_equity=previous,end_equity=value,return_pct=100*(value/previous-1),
            source_sample_time=point["raw_time"],terminal_override=i==3))
        previous=value
    return result
def chain(choices):
    # Synthetic WF rebase: hypothetical product of independent fixed-10000 fold equity ratios.
    # This is not an executed continuous account; do not infer fills/costs at rebased quantities.
    capital=10000.; folds=[]; points=[]
    for i,side in enumerate(choices):
        d=WF[side,i]; startcap=capital
        for pt in d["_curve"]:
            points.append(dict(time=pt["time"],value=startcap*pt["value"]/10000,
                               fold="C"+str(i+1),side=side))
        capital=startcap*d["_terminal"]/10000
        points[-1]["value"]=capital
        folds.append(dict(fold="C"+str(i+1),side=side,initial_equity=startcap,
            final_equity=capital,return_pct=100*(d["_terminal"]/10000-1)))
    return dict(label="synthetic_rebased_WF_not_continuous_account",folds=folds,
                terminal=capital,return_pct=100*(capital/10000-1),
                cagr_pct=100*((capital/10000)**(365/731)-1),points=points)
def entry_key(t):
    return (t["opened_at"],t["type"])
def compact_trade(t):
    return {k:t.get(k) for k in ("id","type","opened_at","closed_at","qty",
             "entry_price","exit_price","fee","funding","PNL")}
def entries(w,r,a,b):
    wt=w["trades"];rt=[t for t in r["trades"] if a*1000<=t["opened_at"]<b*1000]
    wm=defaultdict(list);rm=defaultdict(list)
    for t in wt:wm[entry_key(t)].append(t)
    for t in rt:rm[entry_key(t)].append(t)
    assert all(len(v)==1 for v in wm.values()) and all(len(v)==1 for v in rm.values())
    common=sorted(wm.keys()&rm.keys())
    return dict(wf_n=len(wt),replay_n=len(rt),matched_entry_keys=len(common),
       wf_only=[compact_trade(wm[k][0]) for k in sorted(wm.keys()-rm.keys())],
       replay_only=[compact_trade(rm[k][0]) for k in sorted(rm.keys()-wm.keys())],
       matched=[dict(opened_at=k[0],side=k[1],wf=compact_trade(wm[k][0]),
                     replay=compact_trade(rm[k][0]),
                     qty_ratio=rm[k][0]["qty"]/wm[k][0]["qty"],
                     same_entry_price=rm[k][0]["entry_price"]==wm[k][0]["entry_price"],
                     same_exit_time=rm[k][0]["closed_at"]==wm[k][0]["closed_at"]) for k in common],
       initial_28h=dict(wf_entries=[compact_trade(t) for t in wt if t["opened_at"]<a*1000+28*3600000],
            replay_entries=[compact_trade(t) for t in rt if t["opened_at"]<a*1000+28*3600000]),
       attribution="Observed differences; capital, prior position path, quota/history and OI initialization may interact. Not causal isolation.")
def boundary(d,sec):
    t=sec*1000;ts=d["trades"]
    # Candidates do not prove the within-minute ordering of protective fills vs funding.
    candidates=[x for x in ts if x["opened_at"]<t<=x["closed_at"]]
    exact=[x for x in d["_ledger"] if x["effective_at"]==t]
    near=[x for x in d["_ledger"] if abs(x["effective_at"]-t)<=60000]
    orders=[dict(trade_id=tr["id"],order=o) for tr in ts for o in tr["orders"]
            if o.get("status")=="EXECUTED" and
            any(isinstance(o.get(k),(int,float)) and abs(o[k]-t)<=60000
                for k in ("executed_at","created_at"))]
    return dict(boundary_ms=t,position_candidates=[compact_trade(x) for x in candidates],
       funding_events_exact=exact,funding_cashflow_exact=math.fsum(x["cashflow"] for x in exact),
       funding_events_near=near,executed_orders_near=orders,
       entries_exact=[compact_trade(x) for x in ts if x["opened_at"]==t],
       closes_exact=[compact_trade(x) for x in ts if x["closed_at"]==t],
       first_entry_after=next((compact_trade(x) for x in sorted(ts,key=lambda x:x["opened_at"]) if x["opened_at"]>t),None),
       timing_note="funding effective T precedes decision MARKET T; protective fill in preceding minute may be flat before T. Raw timestamps preserved.")
rows=[]
for side in SIDES:
    r=RP[side];synthetic=chain([side]*4);semesters=replay_semesters(r)
    row=dict(side=side,replay_session_id=r["_session_id"],replay_terminal=r["_terminal"],
       replay_return_pct=100*(r["_terminal"]/10000-1),
       replay_cagr_pct=100*((r["_terminal"]/10000)**(365/731)-1),
       replay_months=r["_monthly"],replay_semesters=semesters,replay_pf_unique_trades=r["_pf"],
       wf_synthetic=synthetic,replay_minus_synthetic_terminal=r["_terminal"]-synthetic["terminal"],
       replay_engine_dd=r["metrics"].get("max_drawdown"),wf_vs_replay_semesters=[],
       curve_terminal_delta=r["_curve_terminal_delta"])
    for i in range(4):
        w=WF[side,i]
        row["wf_vs_replay_semesters"].append(dict(fold="C"+str(i+1),
            wf_session_id=w["_session_id"],wf_terminal=w["_terminal"],
            wf_return_pct=100*(w["_terminal"]/10000-1),replay_equity_semester=semesters[i],
            wf_pf_unique_trades=w["_pf"],wf_engine_dd=w["metrics"].get("max_drawdown"),
            wf_curve_terminal_delta=w["_curve_terminal_delta"],
            entry_comparison=entries(w,r,EDGES[i],EDGES[i+1]),
            start_boundary=dict(wf=boundary(w,EDGES[i]),replay=boundary(r,EDGES[i])),
            end_boundary=dict(wf=boundary(w,EDGES[i+1]),replay=boundary(r,EDGES[i+1]))))
    rows.append(row)
result=dict(definition="Diagnostic comparison, no new gates or strategy selection.",
    global_selector=GLOBAL_SELECTOR,global_selector_synthetic_WF=chain(GLOBAL_SELECTOR),
    calendar="Four separate frozen half-years for each individually eligible variant.",
    rows=rows,oi_initialization_evidence=dict(status="insufficient_for_direct_attribution",
       reason="Backtest analysis snapshots omit strategy logs. No V3_AUDIT/V3_ENTRY logs pasted into code.",
       frozen_source_expectation="Nominal OI uses six 4h initialization decisions once per session; independent WF restarts each fold, replay carries history across internal borders.",
       boundary_return_convention="Equity monthly samples at next00:01 assigned by -61s; terminal actual balance override only at finish. Replay internal boundary funding may differ from finish-exclusive WF.",
       pf_policy="PF calculated only from unique trades within each actual snapshot; never sum or average fold PF."),
    warnings=["Synthetic rebasing is a comparator, not an executed account or financing replay.",
       "Daily curve points are sampled evidence; no invented exact intraminute equity at funding.",
       "Observed entry differences do not uniquely identify OI causality without per-decision logs."])
json.dump(result,open("output/wf_replay_comparison.json","w"),indent=2,allow_nan=False)
print(json.dumps(dict(global_selector=GLOBAL_SELECTOR,comparison=[
    dict(side=x["side"],replay_terminal=x["replay_terminal"],synthetic_terminal=x["wf_synthetic"]["terminal"],
         delta=x["replay_minus_synthetic_terminal"],replay_cagr_pct=x["replay_cagr_pct"]) for x in rows])))

# Text chunks preserve the entire JSON despite 128K artifact transport limit.
serialized=json.dumps(result,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
parts=[]
for i,offset in enumerate(range(0,len(serialized),40000)):
    path="comparison_part_"+str(i).zfill(3)+".txt"
    open("output/"+path,"w",encoding="utf-8").write(serialized[offset:offset+40000])
    parts.append(path)
json.dump(dict(parts=parts,characters=len(serialized)),open("output/comparison_manifest.json","w"))
